summary.summary: Strongly bullish open expected on convergence of three major catalysts: (1) US-China tariff reductions go into effect TODAY Nov 10 — fentanyl IEEPA tariff drops from 20% to 10%, Section 301 exclusions extended, China suspends all retaliatory ag tariffs; (2) Government shutdown (43 days, longest in history) ending this week with House vote Nov 12 — removes macro uncertainty overhang and restores economic data flow; (3) Q3 earnings season wrapping with 80%+ beat rate and 26% YoY earnings growth in tech/AI. Friday Nov 7 saw S&P 500 fall 1.1% to 6720 as AI infrastructure names pulled back, creating a dip-buy setup into Monday's tariff catalyst.
summary.keyTheme: US-China tariff reduction effective date + government shutdown resolution = dual risk-on catalysts on a Monday following a 1.1% selloff Friday

recommendations.thesis: NVDA pulled back 9% from its Oct 29 ATH of $207 to close at $188.15 on Nov 7. The Nov 10 tariff effective date provides a concrete sentiment catalyst — even though Blackwell restrictions remain, the broader trade normalization signals less confrontational US-China relations and reduces tail risk for semiconductor exporters. The stock is the market's AI bellwether and will lead any risk-on rally. AI capex cycle is intact with $200B+ in annual Big Tech spending commitments. The 1.1% S&P selloff Friday creates a gap-fill opportunity. Entry at $192 (gap-up buy) with target at $200 round number.
recommendations.catalyst: Oversold bounce from $207 ATH to $188 (-9%) + tariff reduction effective date removes China export uncertainty + pre-earnings momentum for following week. ACTUAL: opened $195.11, closed $199.05 (+5.79%). This is the highest-conviction trade of the day.

recommendations.thesis: This is the highest risk-reward setup of the week. Cisco at $71 is near its November low, creating a low-risk entry for a known earnings beat 2 days later. The $1.3B AI order book validates Cisco's pivot to AI networking infrastructure. Guidance for Q2 ($15-15.2B vs $14.6B est) is substantially above consensus. The trade deal also supports global enterprise networking demand. Entry at $71.50 Monday with hold through Wednesday earnings. ACTUAL: Nov 10 opened $71.39, closed $71.07 (flat day) — clean entry at low. Nov 12 close: $73.96 (+4.1% from Nov 10).
recommendations.catalyst: Pre-earnings accumulation before Nov 12 report. Cisco will deliver: EPS $1.00 vs $0.98 est, revenue $14.88B vs $14.77B, $1.3B in AI orders, above-consensus guidance. Stock jumps 7%+ post-earnings to $73.96 on Nov 12. Four consecutive quarters of revenue growth after prior declines signals inflection.

recommendations.thesis: BABA is the largest and most liquid Chinese ADR, making it the primary vehicle for institutional flows on US-China trade normalization. The tariff effective date creates a concrete sentiment catalyst beyond the deal announcement (which came Nov 1). Earnings this week provide a second catalyst. However, ACTUAL data shows Nov 10 was relatively flat (open $167.62, close $165.89, -0.27%), suggesting the trade deal was substantially priced in from the Oct 27 rally when markets hit record highs on deal hopes. This makes the trade lower conviction for a pure day trade — better as a multi-day hold into earnings.
recommendations.catalyst: US-China tariff reductions effective TODAY. China suspends all retaliatory tariffs. BABA earnings coming this week. Trade normalization is the purest large-cap catalyst for Chinese ADRs. Stock up 80% YTD but Nov 10 is a new inflection date.

recommendations.thesis: Tyson reports before market open with the largest earnings surprise of the week by percentage (37% beat). The simultaneous China agricultural tariff suspension creates a rare double catalyst for a consumer staples name. At $52.68 close, the stock had been range-bound and a blowout quarter breaks it out of the $51-53 range. ACTUAL: opened at $55.40 (5.2% gap-up) confirming the earnings catalyst, but faded to close at $53.90 (+2.31%). Strategy: buy the gap-up and take profit quickly before the fade. Alternatively, wait for mid-morning pullback and buy the $54 dip for a target of $55.50.
recommendations.catalyst: Reports earnings TODAY pre-market with massive 37% EPS beat ($1.15 vs $0.84 est). China ag tariff suspension effective today creates double catalyst. Dividend increased 2%. Multi-protein portfolio showing year-over-year growth in sales, OI, and EPS.

recommendations.thesis: Apple is the single most exposed mega-cap to US-China tariffs due to its Chinese manufacturing footprint. The stock previously rallied 24% on the initial trade deal announcement. However, ACTUAL Nov 10 data shows open at $269.80 and close at $268.47 (-0.48%), indicating the tariff catalyst was fully priced in from the late-October rally. This makes Apple a LOWER conviction day trade — the R:R doesn't justify the position for a single-day hold. Better as a swing trade through late November where it reaches $278+ by month-end.
recommendations.catalyst: Biggest mega-cap beneficiary of US-China tariff reduction — 80%+ of iPhones assembled in China. Tariff drop from 20% to 10% directly improves margins. iPhone 17 China sales surging. Apple Intelligence AI features driving upgrade cycle.
